parameters.query:
SELECT c.tenant_id, t.sector_code, t.business_name, t.status
FROM channels c JOIN tenants t ON t.id = c.tenant_id
WHERE c.provider = $1 AND c.external_id = $2 AND c.active = true

nodes.name: Identify Tenant by Channel
nodes.notes: Query params: $1 = webhook provider, $2 = webhook external_id (bot/channel identifier). NEVER $ from body.tenant_id. alwaysOutputData=true so an empty result still flows to the Gate node instead of stalling the workflow.

nodes.name: Identify Role and Gate
nodes.notes: Gate flags: proceed / blocked_no_channel / blocked_paused. Role default customer; member-role lookup is TBD (see CHECKLIST).

nodes.name: Route by Gate
nodes.notes: Output 0 = proceed, fallback output 1 = blocked (no channel / paused tenant). Blocked path goes straight to Respond: no AI call, no reply content.

nodes.name: Normalize Arabic
nodes.notes: THE single normalizeArabic() copy in this workflow. Called once, before any matching/search.

parameters.query:
WITH existing AS (
  SELECT ci.customer_id FROM customer_identities ci
  WHERE ci.tenant_id = $1 AND ci.channel = $4 AND ci.provider = $2 AND ci.channel_user_id = $3
),
new_customer AS (
  INSERT INTO customers (tenant_id) SELECT $1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing) RETURNING id
),
customer AS (
  SELECT customer_id AS id FROM existing UNION ALL SELECT id FROM new_customer
),
new_identity AS (
  INSERT INTO customer_identities (tenant_id, customer_id, channel, provider, channel_user_id, verified_by)
  SELECT $1, (SELECT id FROM customer), $4, $2, $3, 'first_seen'
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing) RETURNING customer_id
),
existing_conv AS (
  SELECT id FROM conversations WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND customer_id = (SELECT id FROM customer) AND status = 'open'
  ORDER BY last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
),
new_conv AS (
  INSERT INTO conversations (tenant_id, customer_id, channel)
  SELECT $1, (SELECT id FROM customer), (CASE WHEN $4 IN ('whatsapp', 'telegram', 'web') THEN $4 ELSE 'web' END)
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_conv) RETURNING id
),
conv AS (
  SELECT id FROM existing_conv UNION ALL SELECT id FROM new_conv
),
msg AS (
  INSERT INTO messages (tenant_id, conversation_id, customer_id, sender_role, content, normalized_content, channel_message_id)
  SELECT $1, (SELECT id FROM conv), (SELECT id FROM customer), $5, $6, $7, $8 RETURNING id
),
profile_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO customer_profiles (tenant_id, customer_id, rooms, budget, floor, previous_inquiries_summary, updated_at)
  SELECT $1, (SELECT id FROM customer)::text,
    (regexp_match($7, '([0-9]+)\s*غرف'))[1]::int,
    CASE
      WHEN $7 ~ '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\s*مليون' THEN (regexp_match($7, '([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?)\s*مليون'))[1]::numeric * 1000000
      WHEN $7 ~ '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\s*جنيه' THEN (regexp_match($7, '([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?)\s*جنيه'))[1]::numeric
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    (regexp_match($7, 'دور\s*(ال)?(اول|ارضي|علوي|ثاني|ثالث)'))[2],
    NULL, NOW()
  ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, customer_id) DO UPDATE SET
    rooms = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.rooms, customer_profiles.rooms),
    budget = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.budget, customer_profiles.budget),
    floor = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.floor, customer_profiles.floor),
    updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT $1 AS tenant_id, (SELECT id FROM customer) AS customer_id, (SELECT id FROM conv) AS conversation_id, (SELECT id FROM msg) AS message_id;

nodes.name: Store Inbound Message
nodes.notes: Query params: $1 tenant_id, $2 provider, $3 channel_user_id, $4 channel, $5 sender_role (owner only if Gate role=owner else customer), $6 raw_message, $7 normalized_message, $8 channel message_id. Creates customer (provisional on first sight) + open conversation + message row; ids feed Load and Audit.

parameters.query:
-- FIX 2026-10-29: relevant_items rank by matched keyword length (specific beats generic) and variant-expanded match (ي/ئ/ى, ه/ة, ا/أ/إ/آ, و/ؤ). EXPERIMENT 2026-10-29: relevant_items has no top-5 limit - all matched rows, same ranking order; collection_set is always attached with its true total_count; search_ran=true is emitted.
-- BRAIN REPLACEMENT 2026-10-30: pack CTE (exactly one row: the tenant's sector_code, active only), customer_profiles + tenant_profiles CTEs, data_hash over matched rows else collection rows. matched is re-expressed as a normalized match only (raw-variant chain removed; $2 keywords are already normalized, so the normalized match covers every variant pair).
-- MERGE 2026-10-30: proj_index + projects carry full project details (id, name, area, city, attributes); truncated is honest (attached rows < matching_count).
-- STAGE 2 2026-10-30: voice CTE (tenant_voice_settings, one row or NULL) + pack_settings CTE (tenant_pack_settings, one row or NULL, default auto) + pack resolution: pinned mode with a set version and an existing versions row -> sector_pack_versions row; otherwise the current sector_packs row (a missing pinned version falls back, never empty, never an error). Resolved pack exposes version.
WITH tenant AS (
  SELECT t.id AS tenant_id, t.business_name, t.sector_code FROM tenants t WHERE t.id = $1
),
pol AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('key', policy_key, 'value', policy_value)), '[]'::json) AS policies
  FROM policies WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND is_active
),
tot AS (
  SELECT json_build_object(
    'projects_count', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND is_active),
    'items_count', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND is_active),
    'items_available_count', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND is_active AND status = 'available'),
    'services_count', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_services WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND is_active),
    'lands_total', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND is_active AND kind = 'land'),
    'lands_available', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND is_active AND kind = 'land' AND status = 'available')
  ) AS totals
),
is_coll AS (
  SELECT (COALESCE($4, '') ~ '(قايمه|قائمة|قايمة|منيو|مينيو|لايحه|لائحه|لسته|اصناف|اطباق|وجبات|اكلات|اكل|منتجات|تشكيله|ارض|اراضي|menu)') AS is_collection
),
matched AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.name, i.price, i.currency, i.area, i.status, i.attributes FROM items i WHERE i.tenant_id = $1 AND i.is_active AND (translate(regexp_replace(i.name, '[' || chr(1600) || chr(1611) || '-' || chr(1652) || ']', '', 'g'), 'أإآةىئؤ', 'اااهييو') ~* $2 OR translate(regexp_replace(i.attributes::text, '[' || chr(1600) || chr(1611) || '-' || chr(1652) || ']', '', 'g'), 'أإآةىئؤ', 'اااهييو') ~* $2)
),
rel AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(x), '[]'::json) AS relevant_items, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched) AS matching_count FROM (SELECT * FROM matched ORDER BY (CASE WHEN $2 = '' THEN 0 ELSE (char_length(translate(regexp_replace(name, '[' || chr(1600) || chr(1611) || '-' || chr(1652) || ']', '', 'g'), 'أإآةىئؤ', 'اااهييو')) - char_length(regexp_replace(translate(regexp_replace(name, '[' || chr(1600) || chr(1611) || '-' || chr(1652) || ']', '', 'g'), 'أإآةىئؤ', 'اااهييو'), $2, '', 'g'))) END) DESC, char_length(name) ASC, name ASC) x
),
proj AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('name', name, 'sector', sector_code, 'area', area, 'city', city, 'attributes', attributes, 'count', cnt)), '[]'::json) AS projects FROM (SELECT p.name, p.sector_code, p.area, p.city, p.attributes, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM projects p JOIN items i ON i.project_id = p.id WHERE p.tenant_id = $1 AND p.is_active AND i.is_active GROUP BY p.name, p.sector_code, p.area, p.city, p.attributes) s
),
proj_index AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'name', name, 'area', area, 'city', city, 'attributes', attributes)), '[]'::json) AS project_index FROM projects WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND is_active
),
area_idx AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('name', name, 'area', area, 'price', price)), '[]'::json) AS area_items FROM (SELECT name, area, price FROM items WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND is_active AND area IS NOT NULL ORDER BY area LIMIT 20) s
),
matched_categories AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object('category', cat)), '[]'::json) AS categories FROM (SELECT DISTINCT attributes->>'category' AS cat FROM matched WHERE attributes->>'category' IS NOT NULL) s
),
matched_kinds AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(DISTINCT kind), '[]'::json) AS kinds FROM (SELECT DISTINCT kind FROM items i JOIN matched m ON m.id = i.id) s
),
scope AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT matching_count FROM rel) > 5 THEN 'narrow' ELSE 'broad' END AS scope_hint, (SELECT matching_count FROM rel) AS count_hint
),
collection_match AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.name, i.price, i.currency, i.status, i.attributes, i.kind, i.project_id, i.area FROM items i WHERE i.tenant_id = $1 AND i.is_active AND (((SELECT is_collection FROM is_coll) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched) = 0) OR i.kind IN (SELECT DISTINCT kind FROM items j JOIN matched m ON m.id = j.id))
),
collection_set_raw AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', cm.id, 'name', cm.name, 'price', cm.price, 'currency', cm.currency, 'status', cm.status, 'kind', cm.kind, 'project_id', cm.project_id, 'area', cm.area, 'attributes', cm.attributes)), '[]'::json) AS collection_set, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_match) AS total_count FROM collection_match cm
),
scope_count AS (
  SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched) AS m_count
),
collection_set AS (
  SELECT (SELECT collection_set FROM collection_set_raw) AS collection_set, (SELECT total_count FROM collection_set_raw) AS total_count
),
collection_meta AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN (NOT (SELECT is_collection FROM is_coll)) AND (SELECT m_count FROM scope_count) > 5 THEN NULL ELSE json_build_object('total_count', (SELECT total_count FROM collection_set_raw), 'attached_count', (SELECT total_count FROM collection_set_raw)) END AS collection_meta
),
hist AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('content', content, 'sender_role', sender_role, 'created_at', created_at)), '[]'::json) AS history FROM (SELECT m.content, m.sender_role, m.created_at FROM messages m WHERE m.customer_id = $3 AND m.tenant_id = $1 ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 5) m
),
pack_settings AS (
  SELECT ps.pack_update_mode, ps.pinned_pack_version FROM tenant_pack_settings ps WHERE ps.tenant_id = $1 LIMIT 1
),
current_pack AS (
  SELECT sp.sector_code, sp.display_name, sp.style_opening, sp.style_highlight, sp.style_close, sp.selling_steps, sp.item_fields, sp.forbidden_actions, sp.escalation_triggers, sp.memory_keys, sp.terminology, sp.version FROM sector_packs sp WHERE sp.sector_code = (SELECT sector_code FROM tenant) AND sp.is_active = true LIMIT 1
),
pinned_pack AS (
  SELECT spv.sector_code, spv.display_name, spv.style_opening, spv.style_highlight, spv.style_close, spv.selling_steps, spv.item_fields, spv.forbidden_actions, spv.escalation_triggers, spv.memory_keys, spv.terminology, spv.version FROM sector_pack_versions spv WHERE spv.sector_code = (SELECT sector_code FROM tenant) AND spv.version = (SELECT pinned_pack_version FROM pack_settings) LIMIT 1
),
pack AS (
  SELECT sector_code, display_name, style_opening, style_highlight, style_close, selling_steps, item_fields, forbidden_actions, escalation_triggers, memory_keys, terminology, version FROM (
    SELECT 1 AS prio, pp.* FROM pinned_pack pp
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2 AS prio, cp.* FROM current_pack cp
  ) u WHERE prio = CASE WHEN (SELECT pack_update_mode FROM pack_settings) = 'pinned' AND (SELECT pinned_pack_version FROM pack_settings) IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pinned_pack) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT 1
),
voice AS (
  SELECT vs.dialect, vs.tone, vs.formality, vs.greeting_style, vs.preferred_words, vs.avoided_words, vs.voice_notes FROM tenant_voice_settings vs WHERE vs.tenant_id = $1 LIMIT 1
),
dialect_lex AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('dialect', dialect, 'concept', concept, 'term', term, 'term_value', term_value) ORDER BY dialect, concept, term), '[]'::json) AS dialect_lexicon
  FROM public.dialect_lexicon WHERE is_active
),
cust_instr AS (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('instruction_text', instruction_text, 'category', category, 'priority', priority, 'bound_key', bound_key, 'bound_value', bound_value, 'bound_operator', bound_operator) ORDER BY priority DESC, updated_at DESC, id DESC), '[]'::json) AS custom_instructions FROM tenant_custom_instructions WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND status = 'active' AND (applies_to_sector IS NULL OR applies_to_sector = (SELECT sector_code FROM tenant))),
  cust_prof AS (
  SELECT cp.tenant_id, cp.customer_id, cp.name, cp.contact, cp.interests, cp.budget, cp.area, cp.rooms, cp.floor, cp.preferred_categories, cp.branch, cp.doctor, cp.previous_inquiries_summary, cp.updated_at FROM customer_profiles cp WHERE cp.tenant_id = $1 AND cp.customer_id = $3::text LIMIT 1
),
ten_prof AS (
  SELECT tp.tenant_id, tp.selling_preferences, tp.owner_notes, tp.previous_decisions, tp.updated_at FROM tenant_profiles tp WHERE tp.tenant_id = $1 LIMIT 1
),
cache_cfg AS (
  SELECT (value = 'true') AS cache_on FROM platform_config WHERE key = 'cache_enabled'
),
hash_rows AS (
  SELECT m.id::text AS rid, m.price::text AS rprice, m.status AS rstatus, m.attributes::text AS rattrs FROM matched m UNION ALL SELECT c.id::text, c.price::text, c.status, c.attributes::text FROM collection_match c WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched) = 0 UNION ALL SELECT p.id::text, '' AS rprice, p.status, p.attributes::text FROM projects p WHERE p.tenant_id = $1 AND p.is_active UNION ALL SELECT s.service_code, '' AS rprice, CASE WHEN s.is_active THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END, s.config::text FROM tenant_services s WHERE s.tenant_id = $1
),
data_hash_cte AS (
  SELECT md5(string_agg(hr.rid || '|' || COALESCE(hr.rprice, '') || '|' || COALESCE(hr.rstatus, '') || '|' || COALESCE(hr.rattrs, ''), ',' ORDER BY hr.rid)) AS data_hash FROM hash_rows hr
)
SELECT (SELECT tenant_id FROM tenant) AS tenant_id, (SELECT business_name FROM tenant) AS business_name, (SELECT sector_code FROM tenant) AS sector_code, (SELECT policies FROM pol) AS policies, (SELECT totals FROM tot) AS totals, (SELECT relevant_items FROM rel) AS relevant_items, (SELECT matching_count FROM rel) AS matching_count, (SELECT COALESCE(json_array_length((SELECT relevant_items FROM rel)), 0) < (SELECT matching_count FROM rel)) AS truncated, (SELECT projects FROM proj) AS projects, (SELECT project_index FROM proj_index) AS project_index, (SELECT area_items FROM area_idx) AS area_items, (SELECT categories FROM matched_categories) AS matched_categories, (SELECT kinds FROM matched_kinds) AS matched_kinds, (SELECT scope_hint FROM scope) AS scope, (SELECT collection_set FROM collection_set) AS collection_set, (SELECT collection_meta FROM collection_meta) AS collection_meta, true AS search_ran, (SELECT history FROM hist) AS history, (SELECT row_to_json(p) FROM pack p) AS pack, (SELECT row_to_json(v) FROM voice v) AS voice, (SELECT pack_update_mode FROM pack_settings) AS pack_update_mode, (SELECT pinned_pack_version FROM pack_settings) AS pinned_pack_version, (SELECT row_to_json(c) FROM cust_prof c) AS customer_profile, (SELECT custom_instructions FROM cust_instr) AS custom_instructions,
  (SELECT dialect_lexicon FROM dialect_lex) AS dialect_lexicon, (SELECT row_to_json(t) FROM ten_prof t) AS tenant_profile, (SELECT data_hash FROM data_hash_cte) AS data_hash, (SELECT cache_on FROM cache_cfg) AS cache_enabled;

nodes.name: Load Tenant Data
nodes.notes: ONE combined read. Query params: $1 tenant_id, $2 search_regex from Normalize, $3 customer_id, $4 normalized_message. Returns tenant, policies, totals, top-5 relevant items + projects, matching_count, truncated flag, last-5 history (same tenant + same customer), search_ran=true. For collection/list requests (list keyword in $4), collection_set is the FULL matching set and is never emptied; the top-5 limit applies to relevant_items only. Always returns exactly one row.

nodes.name: Build Reply Prompt
nodes.notes: Assembles system + user prompt from Load output only. Prompt order: system, tenant identity, relevant data + totals + truncation note, policies, history last 8, normalized message. JSON-only output requested.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({model: 'muse-spark-1.3', messages: $json.prompt_messages, temperature: 0.3, max_tokens: 8000, response_format: { type: 'json_object' } }) }}

nodes.name: Prepare Reply Draft
nodes.notes: PLACEHOLDER credential PUT_META_SPARK_CREDENTIAL: create an httpHeaderAuth credential in n8n Cloud with the Meta API key (Authorization: Bearer). NO key value is stored in this JSON. Verify the exact Meta API request fields (reasoning-effort parameter name, JSON-mode support) against Meta docs before import — see CHECKLIST.

nodes.name: Verify Reply Deterministic
nodes.notes: Deterministic Code only, no model opinion. Implements the 7 guard rules + policy + role checks. Verdicts: allowed / correct / blocked (blocked only when the draft is empty). References Load + Normalize nodes by name — renaming those nodes breaks these references.

nodes.name: Route by Verdict
nodes.notes: Output 0 = allowed -> Build Final, output 1 = correct -> Build Correction Prompt, fallback output 2 = blocked -> Build Fallback.

nodes.name: Build Correction Prompt
nodes.notes: Small correction prompt only: original draft + exact violations + correct attached data + totals. No new data is introduced here.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({model: 'muse-spark-1.3', messages: $json.prompt_messages, temperature: 0.3, max_tokens: 8000, response_format: { type: 'json_object' } }) }}

nodes.name: Correct Once
nodes.notes: PLACEHOLDER credential PUT_META_SPARK_CREDENTIAL: create an httpHeaderAuth credential in n8n Cloud with the Meta API key (Authorization: Bearer). NO key value is stored in this JSON. Verify the exact Meta API request fields (reasoning-effort parameter name, JSON-mode support) against Meta docs before import — see CHECKLIST.

nodes.name: Re-verify Corrected
nodes.notes: Same 7-rule logic as Verify Reply Deterministic, kept as a separate node because n8n cannot loop back. Any failure here -> blocked. NO third attempt.

nodes.name: Route Corrected
nodes.notes: Output 0 = corrected reply allowed -> Build Final, fallback output 1 = still failing -> Build Fallback.

nodes.name: Build Final Reply and Cost
nodes.notes: Final reply = verified draft/corrected reply. Cost = prompt*1.25 + completion*4.25 per 1M tokens (Standard pricing); null when the model response carries no usage. Status: passed or corrected.

nodes.name: Build Fallback and Owner Alert
nodes.notes: Honest fallback only, no third model attempt. Sets owner_alert=true with the original message + violations. NOTE: actual delivery of the owner alert to the owner channel is done by admin-ops/adapter outside this workflow (TBD wiring) — this node only produces the alert payload.

parameters.query:
WITH a AS (
    INSERT INTO reply_audit (tenant_id, conversation_id, inbound_message_id, draft_reply, final_reply, status, guard_checks, model, tokens_input, tokens_output, cost_usd, owner_alert, owner_alert_text)
    VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb, $8, $9, $10, $11, $16, $17)
    RETURNING 1
  ),
  b AS (
    INSERT INTO usage_events (tenant_id, workflow_name, model, tokens_input, tokens_output, cost_usd)
    VALUES ($1, 'barqlo-brain-main', $8, $9, $10, $11)
    RETURNING 1
  ),
  c AS (
    INSERT INTO usage_daily (tenant_id, usage_date, model, messages_count, tokens_input, tokens_output, cost_usd, executions_count)
    VALUES ($1, CURRENT_DATE, $8, 1, COALESCE($9, 0), COALESCE($10, 0), COALESCE($11, 0), 1)
    ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, usage_date, model) DO UPDATE SET
      messages_count = usage_daily.messages_count + 1,
      tokens_input = usage_daily.tokens_input + COALESCE(EXCLUDED.tokens_input, 0),
      tokens_output = usage_daily.tokens_output + COALESCE(EXCLUDED.tokens_output, 0),
      cost_usd = usage_daily.cost_usd + COALESCE(EXCLUDED.cost_usd, 0),
      executions_count = usage_daily.executions_count + 1
    RETURNING 1
  )
SELECT $12::text AS final_reply, $13::text AS verdict, $14::uuid AS tenant_id, $15::numeric AS cost_estimate, $16::boolean AS owner_alert, $17::text AS owner_alert_text;

nodes.name: Write Audit and Usage
nodes.notes: ONE transaction: reply_audit INSERT + usage_events INSERT + usage_daily upsert. Query params: $1 tenant_id, $2 conversation_id, $3 message_id, $4 draft_reply, $5 final_reply, $6 status (passed/corrected/blocked), $7 guard_checks JSON, $8 model muse-spark-1.3, $9 tokens_input, $10 tokens_output, $11 cost_usd. Verify multi-statement execution on Cloud before import — see CHECKLIST.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({reply: ($json.final_reply || $json.reply || null), verdict: $json.verdict, tenant_id: $json.tenant_id, cost_estimate: ($json.cost_estimate ?? null), owner_alert: ($json.owner_alert ?? null), owner_alert_text: ($json.owner_alert_text ?? null)}) }}

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook
nodes.notes: Output contract: {reply, verdict, tenant_id, cost_estimate}. Blocked-gate path returns reply=null with verdict blocked_no_channel/blocked_paused.

parameters.query:
WITH cfg AS (
  SELECT (value = 'true') AS cache_on FROM platform_config WHERE key = 'cache_enabled'
),
hit AS (
  SELECT reply_text, verdict FROM response_cache WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND intent_key = $2 AND data_hash = $3 AND COALESCE((SELECT cache_on FROM cfg), false)
)
SELECT reply_text, verdict FROM hit
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::text AS reply_text, NULL::text AS verdict WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hit)

WITH cfg AS (
  SELECT (value = 'true') AS cache_on FROM platform_config WHERE key = 'cache_enabled'
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO response_cache (tenant_id, intent_key, data_hash, reply_text, verdict)
  SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, 'allowed'
  WHERE $2 IS NOT NULL AND $3 IS NOT NULL AND $5 = 'allowed' AND COALESCE((SELECT cache_on FROM cfg), false)
  ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, intent_key, data_hash) DO UPDATE SET reply_text = EXCLUDED.reply_text, verdict = EXCLUDED.verdict, updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT $6 AS tenant_id, $7 AS sector_code, $8 AS conversation_id, $9 AS message_id, $10 AS draft_reply, $11 AS final_reply, $12 AS reply, $13 AS verdict, $14 AS status, $15 AS guard_checks, $16::boolean AS owner_alert, $17 AS owner_alert_text, $18 AS model, $19::int AS tokens_input, $20::int AS tokens_output, $21::float8 AS cost_estimate, $22::float8 AS cost_usd
